causality_rule: Only Chainlink ticks whose received_timestamp_ms is no later than the decision snapshot and only book snapshots no later than the decision snapshot may enter features.
action_rule: Trade only when q_hat - visible_ask - taker_fee_per_share exceeds the calibration-selected buffer and five shares remain at the first WebSocket snapshot at or after 500ms.
calibration_selection: Among buffers with at least 10 calibration attempts and positive total delayed PnL, choose the largest buffer; if none qualify, reject without holdout optimization.
advanced_method_gate: Do not fit Hawkes, HMM, Koopman, neural SDE, or rough-volatility models unless this fixed interpretable state baseline beats the holdout baseline.
